title: About
fullContentHtml:
Welcome to BK School of Research

BK School of Research (BKSR) is basically a research firm that works in Business, Economics, Social Sciences, and Humanities field. The motto of this firm is Research, Reformation and Development which implies that this firm dreams for a developed world by doing research via reformation. Besides research, this organization also creates academic content, publishes a little magazine named Saptasudha, and many other educative and entertainment contents. BK School of Research was first founded by Bezon Kumar in October 2015 while it started its official journey in December 2016. BKSR generally works with young students, researchers, and university teachers. At present, about 30 research scholars over the world are now working at BK School of Research. Till now, more than 15 research works have been completed which have been published in different international peer-reviewed Journals and Books.

BK School of Research works co-operatively among its researchers, fellows, and members. Anyone who has recently enrolled or passed a Bachelor's and Master's Degree in Business, Economics, Social Sciences, and Humanities can be a member of this academic platform and can work as a team member. BKSR provides special nursing to them who are immature but dedicated to research or other academic works. This research firm helps researchers by providing various research-related technical and academic supports and facilities like editing and proofreading, checking plagiarism, statistical software, inputting and analyzing data, reviewing reports, academic lessons, educative entertainment, experience certificate and so on. BK School of Research dreams to make a green, peaceful, prosperous, non-discriminating, and non-depriving world by doing innovative research, building awareness among people, educating people, and so on. These go with the tagline of BKSR, a heaven for inquisitive minds.

Mission: The mission of BK School of Research is to do research on social issues, educate and train up people, and build awareness among people.

Vision: The vision of BK School of Research is to contribute to making a green, peaceful, prosperous, non-discriminating, and non-depriving world.

title: Director
fullContentHtml:
Director


Bezon Kumar
Lecturer in Economics
Rabindra University, Bangladesh

Bezon Kumar, a Lecturer in Economics at Rabindra University, Bangladesh is a professional researcher. He has a number of international peer-reviewed journal articles and he is now engaged in many research projects. Before he served at Varendra University as a Lecturer in Economics from 2017 to 2019. Besides teaching and research, he writes columns in the newspaper, writes poems, short stories, articles, and so on. He has also a deep devotion to drawing and photography. In leisure, he also likes reading books, gardening, caring pets, playing cricket, listening to music, and watching movies. Making films is a great passion to him and he has some own directed short films.
He is now working as the Director of BK School of Research.
